description: Source code for memory page management in jemalloc, including functions for mapping, unmapping, committing, decommitting, and setting huge page states, with system-specific implementations and configuration detection.

methods.name: os_pages_map
methods.description: Maps memory pages with optional alignment and commit flag, using system-specific calls.

methods.name: os_pages_trim
methods.description: Trims over-allocated memory pages to the desired size and alignment.

methods.name: os_pages_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps memory pages, handling system-specific calls and errors.

methods.name: pages_map_slow
methods.description: Creates an aligned memory mapping by over-allocating and trimming.

methods.name: pages_map
methods.description: Creates a memory mapping with specified size and alignment, attempting precise mapping first.

methods.name: pages_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps memory pages.

methods.name: pages_commit_impl
methods.description: Commits or decommits memory pages based on the commit flag.

methods.name: pages_commit
methods.description: Commits memory pages.

methods.name: pages_decommit
methods.description: Decommits memory pages.

methods.name: pages_purge_lazy
methods.description: Performs lazy purge of memory pages, system-specific.

methods.name: pages_purge_forced
methods.description: Forcibly purges memory pages, system-specific.

methods.name: pages_huge_impl
methods.description: Sets huge page advice with optional alignment.

methods.name: pages_huge
methods.description: Sets huge pages with alignment.

methods.name: pages_huge_unaligned
methods.description: Sets huge pages without alignment.

methods.name: pages_nohuge_impl
methods.description: Sets no-huge page advice with optional alignment.

methods.name: pages_nohuge
methods.description: Sets no-huge pages with alignment.

methods.name: pages_nohuge_unaligned
methods.description: Sets no-huge pages without alignment.

methods.name: pages_dontdump
methods.description: Sets pages to be excluded from core dumps.

methods.name: pages_dodump
methods.description: Includes pages in core dumps.

methods.name: os_page_detect
methods.description: Detects system page size.

methods.name: os_overcommits_sysctl
methods.description: Detects overcommit setting via sysctl.

methods.name: os_overcommits_proc
methods.description: Detects overcommit setting via /proc/sys.

methods.name: pages_set_thp_state
methods.description: Sets transparent huge page state for a memory region.

methods.name: init_thp_state
methods.description: Initializes transparent huge page mode based on system settings.

methods.name: pages_boot
methods.description: Performs system-specific initialization for page management.
